ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Social Services Fraud Scandal

questions: What were the payment amounts and frequencies?
ideas.insight: This story would provide a detailed analysis of the financial transactions involved in the scandal, potentially uncovering more evidence of corruption and fraud.
